newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stock markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian stock markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Major Indian stock markets were closed on Thursday for a national holiday. They will reopen Friday.
Blue chips ended higher on Wednesday but off their intra-day peak as profit-booking cut into a sharp early rally made on news former finance minister P. Chidambaram was returning to the government.
The Bombay Stock Exchange top 30 index closed on Wednesday up 32.46, or 0.85 percent, at 3,841.11.
The National index rose 22.40 points to 1,079.85.
The Delhi index closed 2.62 points higher at 801.24, the Calcutta index gained 0.76 to 107.11. The Madras index jumped 36.49 points to 3,722.16.
